raw_posts.name: Dedica
raw_posts.tagline: Check if AI agents can use your website
raw_posts.description: Dedica tests your website the way AI agents use it, then gives your team a fix for every place they fail. Muse, Instinct, GrokBot and other agents now browse, compare and sign up on people's behalf. Dedica runs 125 checks (for free) to see if they can use your site, and gives you a fix for every issue to hand to your coding agent.

raw_posts.name: bytemail
raw_posts.tagline: Native Mac email: every inbox, in your notch, no trackers
raw_posts.description: bytemail is a native Mac email app built in Swift. Gmail, iCloud, Outlook, Yahoo, Fastmail and any IMAP account in one fast window. New mail and sign-in codes grow out of your MacBook's notch, Undo Send flies a paper plane through it, and desktop widgets show what's unread. Tracking pixels are blocked, look-alike senders flagged, and your mail never touches our servers. Snooze, rules, one-click unsubscribe, and an MCP server for Claude and other AI apps. iPhone beta included. 7-day free trial.

raw_posts.name: BotGauge
raw_posts.tagline: The trust layer for your agents
raw_posts.description: AI agents don't just generate answers anymore. They take actions, call tools, and access real data. BotGauge helps engineering teams find where agents break before users do. Run adaptive red-team attacks and evals, catch security and behavioral failures, and replay every issue with full traces. Turn failures into regression tests, continuously retest as your agents evolve, and monitor their behavior in production. One reliability layer from development to deployment.

raw_posts.name: Fraud Blocker
raw_posts.tagline: AI ad fraud protection for Google and Meta ads
raw_posts.description: Fraud Blocker is an AI-powered platform that blocks invalid ad traffic from bots, click farms, and AI agents, ensuring enterprises, marketers, and agencies pay only for real clicks and genuine leads. It uses AI agents trained on billions of clicks and IPs to identify sophisticated invalid traffic that traditional filters miss, then explains why each click or IP was blocked. This helps protect budgets, improve conversion quality, and reduce wasted ad spend.

raw_posts.name: Tulu
raw_posts.tagline: Autonomous marketing operations & analytics for SMBs
raw_posts.description: Say ta-ta to manual work, and get the right answers without messing with UTMs, spreadsheets or...anything else. See where marketing spend produces revenue, and get alerts straight to WhatsApp when something actually needs your attention. Integrate offline spend, share views to align the entire team, and finally stop guessing with your budget. Get to the insights that matter, so you can decide exactly where to put your next euro.

raw_posts.name: Trigger.dev: Webhooks for your AI agents
raw_posts.tagline: Run AI agents with Slack, Supabase and 50+ other services
raw_posts.description: Trigger.dev Webhooks let you build AI agents on top of the services your customers already use, like Slack, Supabase and Stripe. A GitHub pull request can start a code review agent, a new Sentry issue can start an agent that writes the fix, and a Stripe refund can wait for a human to approve it in Slack.

raw_posts.name: LFM3 by Liquid AI
raw_posts.tagline: Six 2B-class models for phones, laptops and robots
raw_posts.description: LFM3 is Liquid AI’s third generation of Liquid Foundation Models, with open weights and a shared backbone across text, vision, audio, omni and decision models. The first release is six 2B-class models, including a 1.7B text model that fits in about 1 GB at 4-bit and has a 256K context. Liquid says they run on phones, laptops and edge devices and can be fine-tuned on one GPU. Weights are on Hugging Face.

raw_posts.name: App Store Screenshots
raw_posts.tagline: Your coding agent designs your app store screenshots
raw_posts.description: A free, open-source skill for Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor. Give your agent your app captures and a short brief, and it builds a local screenshot editor in your project. Choose from 18 styles, compare looks in Style Lab, edit the copy, and export every size for iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Android, in multiple languages. No screenshot subscription. It runs locally; your usual agent costs apply. Install: npx skills add ParthJadhav/app-store-screenshots

raw_posts.name: Genie 4
raw_posts.tagline: Turn a prompt into a living world you can steer
raw_posts.description: Genie 4 is Google DeepMind’s new real-time world model for creators, game developers and AI researchers. Unlike video generators that hand you a finished clip, Genie 4 builds a world you walk through with your keyboard and steer with text as it runs: change the weather, add a character, set an event in motion. It generates native audio and live dialogue, simulates physics and natural human motion, and uses Gemini to keep scenes coherent. Research preview, waitlist open now.
